text:
Progress to 2026-11-10 on low [alpha/Fe], Mg b and age. Numbers are posterior medians.

1. Carbon mask on LEGA-C (results/carbon-mask-2026-11-08; CN4150, G4300, Fe4383, C2 4668 Lick bandpasses, 208 A rest): 61 galaxies covering Mg b, [alpha/Fe] +0.088 -> +0.201, paired shift +0.127, up in 97%. Same galaxies: mass-weighted age +0.32 Gyr (16-84: +0.07..+0.70, older in 85%), [Fe/H] -0.10 dex (lower in 100%), tau_dust -0.015. Baseline = October refit (the same-pin baseline reproduces it on the 10-galaxy check).
2. Age-redshift slope, same 61 galaxies, z 0.60-0.83, straight-line fit, galaxy bootstrap: baseline d(age)/dz = -2.8 +- 2.3 Gyr; carbon mask -4.8 +- 2.5 Gyr; d(t_univ)/dz = -5.8 Gyr (Planck18, as in the fit). Age scatter about the line 0.85 Gyr. rho([alpha/Fe], z) = -0.22 baseline, -0.38 carbon mask.
3. Literature (table with section cites: ~/.claude/scripts/hermes-bridge/results/t_78a5100f.md): no Prospector full-spectrum paper in wiki/notes/papers-update-2025-2026.md masks CN4150, G4300, Fe4383 or C2 4668; stated masks are sky lines (Tacchella+2022), rest < 1200 A (Zhang+2026), Na D (Turner+2025). Leung+2026 Sect. 4.1 masks Ca H+K only in the variable-[alpha/Fe] runs: "calcium in the ISM can also provide a substantial contribution to these lines (e.g., Murga et al. 2015), which has the potential to bias our measurements of [a/Fe]". Leung does not mention Ca I 4227.
4. MaNGA DR17, 8 red galaxies, 72 fits (results/manga-afe-2026-11-09; per-galaxy table on board card t_3a4afb1a): full range [alpha/Fe] median 0.20, at or above Conroy+2014 Table 1 [Mg/Fe] at matched sigma in 7/8 (median 0.10), below Parikh+2019 stacks (0.22-0.29). Restricting to rest 3860-5330 A (median LEGA-C fitted range) gives 0.14; the carbon mask there adds +0.10, at full range +0.01. Cause of the window drop not established: tau_dust also changes (prior edge 1.0 at full range, 0.41-0.63 in the window).
5. MaNGA noise floor: the production spectrum floor f_calib*|mu| uses the uncalibrated model. Dust plus the order-10 polynomial reshape that floor; spectrum lnL gains about 1800 from tau 0 -> 1 (10504-12702), flat (+-25) with the floor f*|y| on the data. With f*|y|: tau 0.36-0.46 (was 0.65-1.00), polynomial flat, W1 obs/model 0.99-1.03, mass-weighted age 6.8-9.2 Gyr (was 8.4-11.1), [alpha/Fe] -0.08..+0.01. Not yet run on LEGA-C.
6. WISE W1/W2 scaling is correct: unWISE totals agree with AllWISE 24.75 arcsec aperture mags within 0.2 mag; 2MASS Ks shares the excess. The [O I] 5577 mask changes [alpha/Fe] by 0.00-0.04.

Not tested: (a) free C and N (and Ca) abundance responses instead of masks; (b) the f*|y| floor on the 10-galaxy LEGA-C test set; (c) which pixels lower [alpha/Fe] in the short window at fixed dust and floor; (d) the age-redshift slope on the full 135 with any of these changes.
